cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

project(rodakos_icon_preview LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

get_filename_component(RODAKOS_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(LVGL_ROOT "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/managed_components/lvgl__lvgl")
set(HOME_UI_TESTS "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/tests/home_ui")

# Candidate desktop icon fonts generated by generate_fonts.py. Each file defines one lv_font_t
# named after the file; the preview selects them at run time.
set(RODAKOS_ICON_PREVIEW_FONT_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Directory of generated candidate icon fonts")
if(NOT RODAKOS_ICON_PREVIEW_FONT_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Set RODAKOS_ICON_PREVIEW_FONT_DIR to the generate_fonts.py output")
endif()
file(GLOB candidate_fonts "${RODAKOS_ICON_PREVIEW_FONT_DIR}/icon_*_30.c")
if(NOT candidate_fonts)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No icon_*_30.c fonts in ${RODAKOS_ICON_PREVIEW_FONT_DIR}")
endif()
set(candidate_list "")
foreach(font_source ${candidate_fonts})
    get_filename_component(font_name "${font_source}" NAME_WE)
    string(APPEND candidate_list "X(${font_name})\n")
endforeach()
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/candidate_fonts.inc" "${candidate_list}")

set(LV_BUILD_CONF_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lv_conf.h" CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_BUILD_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CONFIG_LV_USE_THORVG_INTERNAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${LVGL_ROOT}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/lvgl")

add_executable(rodakos_icon_preview
    icon_preview.cc
    ${candidate_fonts}
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/apps/home/home_app.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/apps/home/home_layout_model.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/apps/home/home_layout_codec.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/apps/home/home_layout_store.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/phone_os/phone_app_registry.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/phone_ui/phone_components.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/phone_ui/phone_theme.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/phone_ui/phone_ui.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/phone_ui/rodakos_layout.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/phone_ui/rodakos_theme.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main/phone_ui/soft_keyboard.cc"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/components/rodakos_fonts/src/rodakos_icons_20_4.c"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/components/rodakos_fonts/src/rodakos_icons_30_4.c"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/components/rodakos_fonts/src/font_puhui_16_4.c"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/components/rodakos_fonts/src/font_edix_36_4.c"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/tests/app_model/third_party/cjson/cJSON.c"
)

# The Home UI fakes replace platform services, but this target links the production font
# sources instead of the Montserrat-only phone_fonts fake.
target_include_directories(rodakos_icon_preview BEFORE PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fakes"
    "${HOME_UI_TESTS}/fakes"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/main"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/tests/app_model/third_party/cjson"
    "${RODAKOS_ROOT}/components/rodakos_fonts/include"
)
target_link_libraries(rodakos_icon_preview PRIVATE lvgl)
if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(rodakos_icon_preview PRIVATE m)
endif()
